title: Derive which property branches a literal-keyed flb_service_set call takes
why: W47-LOOP-OWNER-INSTANCE-FLOW ties the fixed in_tail pause test's list-head instance (tests/runtime/in_tail.c:2551-2552 at 90978ac6) to its one creation, flb_input(ctx->flb, "tail", NULL) at :226, except for one call on the path: flb_service_set(ctx->flb, "Flush", ..., "Grace", ..., "Log_Level", ..., "Parsers_File", ..., NULL) at :218-223. flb_service_set passes each key/value pair to flb_config_set_property (src/flb_lib.c:674-700), which dispatches on the key's text (src/flb_config.c:855-): the Plugins_File branch (:903-907) loads shared-object and Go-proxy input plugins (flb_plugin_load_router > flb_plugin_load, a registration into config->in_plugins at src/flb_plugin.c:251, and flb_plugin_proxy_register, which calls the plugin's entry point through a function pointer). The census reads calls, not the keys a variadic call carries, so it counts flb_service_set as a second hazard-reaching call and, since its closure then makes an unmodelled indirect call, admits escaped functions that reach a hazard. Size: 1 call site holding 3 declared sites (cb_tail_pause_test :2483, :2492, :2494), unresolved at both census readings of 90978ac6; a diagnostic reading with lines 218-223 blanked (artifacts/counterfactual, never reported as a site result) derives the instance and discharges all 3 on (flb_lib_worker, NonThreaded) and (input_thread, Threaded). The observation is recorded, held for review, in fluent_bit/input_instance.qv's flb_service_set declaration. DISCHARGE: a reading that evaluates a variadic call's literal key arguments against flb_config_set_property's key comparisons (strncasecmp against the service_configs table) and follows only the branches those keys take, fail-closed on any non-literal key, measured on the census.

title: Review the four instance-flow contracts held for human review
why: W47-LOOP-OWNER-INSTANCE-FLOW recorded the Fluent Bit observations its census needed as pinned provider contracts (providers/quirin-provider-fluent-bit/contracts/fluent_bit/input_instance.qv: flb_create, flb_input, flb_input_new, flb_service_set; pinned at 66910c10, 046accf6 and the 90978ac6 export; selected by cycle19-resource-contracts.json and every fluent_bit resource view). Their custody clauses were read against the bodies at the three trees (flb_create, flb_input, flb_service_set byte-identical; flb_input_new differs by one TLS field initialisation); 7 clauses are wrapped in resource_review_pending because resource v1 cannot state them: a retained pointer (flb_input's data; flb_input_new's config and data), an instance's list membership and coroutine flag (flb_input_new's result), a list's contents (flb_create's result: P-FRESH-CONTEXT, P-REGISTERED-DESCRIPTORS), a creation's success (flb_input's result: P-HEAD-INSTANCE) and a key-dependent effect (flb_service_set's variadic tail). Each declaration is withheld: every call site that would apply it is held awaiting-human-review (see the report's arbiter section for the held sites). The census's remaining stated premises P-HOLDER-OPAQUE and P-INSTANCE-FIELDS-BY-MEMBER have no function to carry them and stay stated in rule 10p. DISCHARGE: a person decides each held clause; a clause whose reason says retained is resolved only by a vocabulary that states the retention (never by unwrapping it as written), the others by confirming the observation and a v1 extension that states it, re-pinned.
